weak_topics.problem: Several titles fit consciousness/perception (mental music, attention, near-death experiences), but the population is diluted by unclear or unrelated items such as “Hypocritespy” and “Continual Speaker Identity Unlearning with Minimal Interference,” which is primarily ML/speech-model research.

Mobile side channels, malware-loaded phones, phone hardening, and mobile forensics fit, but major unrelated populations dilute the label: CrowdStrike Linux kernel crashes, solar-inverter security, and a generic company root-access incident are not mobile-device security.

Several titles fit Iran or regional conflict, but the population is diluted by unrelated Craig Murray/Iceland, an Indonesian stadium crush, and a Taliban execution in Afghanistan; the Lebanese bank-hostage item is only loosely regional.

Some valid wellness-tracking content appears, including workout tracking, Daily time tracking, fever support, and routines, but the population is too mixed: Yu-Gi-Oh health points, dog-care education, and generic morning-routine discussion are not personal wellness tracking.

The label is too narrow for a mixed population: Framework and the MiniDisc laptop fit, but homelab posts, generic DIY savings, computing history, and device age-attestation are not primarily personal-computer/laptop selection or maintenance.
